items.title: Photo ID
items.explainer: A passport or national ID. Anna needs to confirm it's really you.
items.lookLike: The photo page of your passport.

items.title: Your tax ID
items.explainer: Your 11-digit Steuer-ID. Everyone in Germany gets one by post.
items.lookLike: A letter from the Bundeszentralamt für Steuern.

items.title: Annual income statement
items.explainer: Your employer sent this in February, it summarises your salary and the tax you already paid.
items.lookLike: One page, a grid of numbered boxes.

items.title: Unemployment benefits statement
items.explainer: The letter from the Agentur für Arbeit confirming your unemployment benefits. It's the reason your filing is required.

items.title: Bank details for your refund
items.explainer: Where your refund should land. IBAN is enough.
items.lookLike: Your IBAN, from your banking app.

items.title: Receipts that could raise your refund
items.explainer: Work equipment, relocation costs, courses, optional, but often worth real money.
items.lookLike: Any receipts or invoices you kept.
